items.title: AI Money Moves Put These Five Stocks In Spotlight Last Week: NVDA, INTC, ORCL, AMD, SNDK
items.summary: Tech companies are raising money, increasing production, and changing their plans as AI spending stays strong, while investors watch costs and how well companies deliver on their promises.

items.title: Cloudflare CEO Says the Internet Is Changing Exponentially
items.summary: Lost in the commotion of earnings season, Cloudflare co-founder and CEO Matthew Prince made an extraordinary claim about how internet traffic is changing at an exponential rate, motivating Jon to ask Matt and Tyler to dissect the news and look for investment opportunities. The trio also discusses the latest news in the mining industry as well as Intel’s latest equity sale.

items.title: Wall Street’s Biggest Funds Are Dumping Broadcom and Adding Taiwan Semiconductor. Time to Follow the ‘Smart Money?’
items.summary: Top hedge funds quietly rotated out of one chip giant and piled into another last quarter, and the price action since then suggests they knew something. Here is what Druckenmiller, Loeb, and Tepper actually did with their semiconductor books.

items.title: Stanley Druckenmiller’s Big Bet: New Broadcom, Intel and Arm Stakes in One Quarter
items.summary: Stanley Druckenmiller opened three brand-new semiconductor positions in a single quarter, and the names he chose reveal a calculated bet that the AI infrastructure boom has room to grow far beyond the obvious winner.

items.title: What Could Intel (INTC) Returning To Memory Mean For Investors?
items.summary: Intel (NasdaqGS: INTC) CEO has signaled a possible return to the memory market, positioning the company as a potential rival to Micron and SK Hynix. The move would mark a shift for Intel, which previously exited the memory segment after divesting related operations. A renewed focus on memory could expand Intel's product mix and affect how it competes and partners across the semiconductor industry. items.title: At AI-Fueled Market Party, Wall Street Eyes the Rates Punch Bowl
items.summary: Enthusiasm for Big Tech and its huge investments in artificial intelligence is powering the stock market to record highs again. With a resilient economy and scorching demand, there’s seemingly only one obstacle that can derail this ride: higher interest rates.

items.title: Nvidia’s Secret $21 Billion SpaceX Windfall — How One Chip Deal Turned Into a Rocket Fortune
items.summary: Nvidia cut a check for an AI startup and woke up owning a massive stake in Elon Musk's rocket empire. The chain of events that turned a chip deal into one of the most unusual positions on any tech company's balance sheet raises a question shareholders probably never thought to ask.
